data.content: Union Mall revitalizes the historic 1927 Union Building, blending its heritage with modern design.
We collaborated with Union Mall to enhance their online presence through web design, social media, and animation, aligning with their mission of exceptional service.

We collaborated with Union to create a website that features a contemporary aesthetic that honors the architectural legacy of the Union Building while promoting an inviting atmosphere for exploration.

With vibrant visuals and intuitive navigation, the site showcases over 200 brands and dining options, serving as a digital gateway to unique experiences that foster community engagement and memorable visits.
We aimed to enhance Union's social media presence by merging classic design elements with contemporary aesthetics.
Our strategy focused on crafting visually striking content and interactive campaigns that celebrate Union's historical roots while inviting the community to explore its modern shopping experience.

We crafted vibrant animations for Union that showcase its prime location and new shops and restaurants. These visuals guide visitors to the shopping center while highlighting its modern features and inviting the community to explore all Union offers.

Union experienced an uptick in foot traffic and enhanced online visibility following our digital campaign. The engaging animations highlighted its diverse shops and restaurants, reinforcing Union's status as a premier shopping destination while celebrating its rich heritage.
